author: spidey simp
description: Automatically removes Discord nicknames containing links and provides moderators with a command to scan the entire server for linked names.
install_msg: Thank you for installing NoLinksInNames! Use `[p]load nolinksinnames` to get started. The bot requires permission to manage nicknames for automatic enforcement and guild-wide checks.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no end user data.
